design.objective: Commit project and attachment metadata deletion before asynchronously and recoverably removing the associated object storage objects.

requirements.statement: Project deletion must record all project attachment deletion intents in its database transaction and must not call object storage deletion.
acceptance: project test has one enqueue call
storage delete has no transaction interaction

requirements.statement: A post-commit worker must complete successful object cleanup and persist a retryable failure state for unsuccessful deletion.
acceptance: exception becomes RETRY with attempt count

requirements.statement: The outbox must prevent duplicate active attachment cleanup events and recover abandoned processing leases.
counterexample: two project deletions create duplicate cleanup work

requirements.statement: Project deletion authorization, audit and related-data cleanup behavior must remain intact.
acceptance: no attachment project can be deleted outside scope

requirements.statement: The schema must be append-only and recoverable after an application rollback.

invariants: No object storage credentials are stored or logged
No synchronous storage delete in project transaction
Every event has tenant and attachment scope

selected_approach.name: Transactional outbox with scheduled lease worker
selected_approach.reason: Keeps the database transaction short and makes storage failures visible and retryable without a new broker.

alternatives.name: external message queue
alternatives.rejected_because: unnecessary new dependency for current deployment.

components.name: ProjectAttachmentCleanupOutboxService
components.responsibility: claim, call storage after transaction, finish or retry

performance: no network I/O in project transaction
operations: event states and attempts observable in DB

assumptions.text: MinIO delete may be safely retried for the same object key.
assumptions.falsifier: storage adapter treats absent object as unrecoverable.

decisions.decision: Use unique tenant/attachment outbox event and expired lease recovery
decisions.reason: enforces idempotent enqueue and restart safety

risks.risk: processing event remains leased after process loss

approval.evidence: User confirmed this remaining optimization and authorized all subsequent confirmations.
